objective: Implement the local deterministic feedback-intake to signal-inbox vertical slice defined by ADR-0002 while preserving one-to-one lineage and append-only manual triage.
scope: Implement the TypeScript and Next.js modular-monolith boundaries defined by ADR-0002.
Implement Feedback Intake and Signal Inbox bounded contexts with public application ports.
Use Prisma and PostgreSQL to create one Feedback and one Signal atomically with a unique Signal.feedbackId lineage constraint.
Implement the versioned local HTTP contract in docs/contracts/SD-001.md.
Require bounded UTF-8 JSON, explicit content acknowledgement, and pre-persistence rejection of documented high-confidence secret and regulated-data patterns.
Implement append-only human-requested TriageEvent writes and revision-safe Signal inbox projections.
Enforce declared TypeScript dependency direction with dependency-cruiser.
Produce ordered Foundation, Component, Integration, Workflow, and Stress evidence without advancing past a failed level.
non_goals: Authentication, authorization, verified identity, tenancy, or multi-user isolation.
Hosted, internet-facing, production, release, deployment, or autonomous-operation readiness.
Complete secret detection, complete regulated-data detection, or complete DLP.
File uploads, attachments, object storage, or attachment scanning.
Probabilistic inference, feedback grouping, deduplication, synthesis, issue prioritization, or model-based triage.
Billing, enterprise administration, background workers, external integrations, or application-user memory.
Agent authority to merge, release, deploy, promote learning, or approve architecture exceptions.
evidence_plan: Foundation: validate governed JSON artifacts against the installed Elder schemas; validate TypeScript, Prisma schema, public contract fixtures, and fail-closed dependency-cruiser boundaries.
Component: prove each bounded context's validation, deterministic creation, error contracts, append-only triage, revision checks, and restricted-content rejection in isolation.
Integration: prove PostgreSQL transaction atomicity, unique one-feedback-to-one-signal lineage, Prisma repository behavior, and cross-context workflow contracts.
Workflow: exercise feedback submission through Signal Inbox visibility and a manual triage append using only the local product HTTP and user interface boundaries.

Stress: prove maximum-body enforcement, concurrent lineage and triage conflict behavior, database failure recovery, detector failure behavior, and absence of raw confidential content in logs and telemetry.
Human review: Neel reviews public-contract compatibility, security limitations, evidence, and the retained-authority boundary before any merge or later release decision.
